finding.observed_source: apps/mobile/src/ui/manage.tsx:1686–1768 AboutScreen reads model only for Back navigation. finding.impact: About cannot distinguish an independently admitted current research account from an ordinary, revoked or mismatched account. This is a missing required status presentation, not a demonstrated grant of research/capture authority.
finding.verification_method: Read-only whole-function and shared-render-tree/control-flow inspection; no runtime/build/test executed.
finding.required_correction: After explicit human handling of exhausted correction2/2, make About render a truthful current account scope using existing validated owner/generation/offline/capability guards. Do not grant capability or infer approval from sign-in/version.
finding.verification_criterion: About distinguishes admitted versus ordinary/guest/offline/revoked/wrong-owner/generation states; existing shared workspaceScope assertions may be reused with direct production About call-path evidence. No duplicate test is required if current meaningful shared proof establishes the final integration.
finding.minimum_next_action: Human scope/budget adjudication or already-existing evidence that this exact About clause is satisfied. Do not silently waive it or perform automatic correction round3.
finding.actual_about_source_excerpt:
export function AboutScreen({ controller, model }: ScreenProps) {
  return (
    <Page
      title="About this release"
      eyebrow="One The Go Detection"
      onBack={action(controller, () =>
        controller.navigate(
          model.state?.acknowledgedNotice || model.identity
            ? "settings"
            : "welcome",
        ),
      )}
    >
      <Card>
        <Title small>Research measurement platform</Title>
        <Paragraph>
          This application organizes optional profile context, saliva
          measurements, eye and cardiac evidence, native reaction practice, and
          a separate alcohol channel. It preserves quality, provenance,
          timestamps and immutable evidence links.
        </Paragraph>
        <Notice tone="warning">
          Ordinary and guest checks are measurement records. A separately
          admitted qualified research result may describe only its named
          historical endpoint; scientific approval and current evidence are
          required. The app does not provide driving clearance.
        </Notice>
        <Fact label="App version" value={BUILD.version} />
        <Fact label="Environment" value={BUILD.environment.toUpperCase()} />
        <Fact label="Application contract" value="1.0.0" />
        <Fact label="Measurement snapshot" value="0.1.0" />
        <Fact
          label="Research result reader"
          value={
            BUILD.hostedPreview
              ? "Fictional measurement-only preview"
              : "Version 1.1 proof-bound research endpoint support; no model or approval is bundled"
          }
        />
        <Fact
          label="Native runtime"
          value={`${Platform.OS} ${String(Platform.Version)}`}
        />
        <Fact
          label="Build number"
          value={Constants.nativeBuildVersion ?? "Development / web preview"}
        />
        <Fact
          label="Toolchain"
          value="Expo 57 · React Native 0.86 · Node 22.13+"
        />
        <Fact
          label="Android support"
          value="Minimum API 24 · compile/target API 36"
        />
        <Fact label="iOS support" value="Minimum iOS 16.4 · Xcode 26.4+" />
        <Paragraph muted>
          Host software checks are recorded in the repository verification
          report. Physical Android/iPhone acquisition, OS permission
          round-trips, screen-reader review and calibrated timing remain
          unexecuted release checks until their evidence is recorded.
        </Paragraph>
      </Card>
      <Card>
        <Title small>What remains a qualification gate</Title>
        <Paragraph>
          Human assay validation, optical scale and photometric testing, ECG
          electrical/device safety, breath-instrument validation, physical
          reaction timing calibration, approved study authorization, regulatory
          decisions and a clinically validated inference model require evidence
          outside this software build.
        </Paragraph>
      </Card>
      <Button
        title="Read application notice"
        secondary
        onPress={action(controller, () => controller.navigate("notice"))}
      />
    </Page>
  );
}
